toolsOverBudget.configure_template_fields: One call configures every field of a template: who fills it, its input control, options and validation, one union member per field kind.
toolsOverBudget.counterparty_check: Register and sanctions checks share four subject variants and birth dates at three precisions; identity inputs and per-list result guidance must remain explicit.
toolsOverBudget.create-document: The document source grammar the compiler reads (headings, clauses, tables, numbering) is the contract, and the description states what the tool must not be used for.
toolsOverBudget.create_reader_annotation: A mark anchors to a decision or statute passage, so the call carries the target, quoted passages with their anchors, and the visibility rules.
toolsOverBudget.discover_tools: Its description lists every sandbox API the model can discover; that list is what keeps those APIs out of the eager tool set.
toolsOverBudget.save_clause: A clause body is structured paragraphs (styles, levels, runs, list kinds), so the library keeps the formatting a draft reuses.
toolsOverBudget.save_contact: People and organizations share one upsert with their name parts, identifiers and nationality codes.
toolsOverBudget.save_playbook: Creates a playbook or edits its positions in one call; each position carries the rule, fallback and source the model has to write.
toolsOverBudget.save_time_entry: A time entry carries the billing fields an invoice needs: both narratives, billable and no-charge flags, task and activity codes.
toolsOverBudget.set_field_value: The content object is a union over every property value type, each spelled out so the model matches the property's type.
